source: 关千用好采购领域突出问题典型案例加大警示教育的通知
translation: Notice on Strengthening Warning Education Regarding Typical Cases of Problems in the Procurement Field

source: 公司各部门、各直属机构、所属各单位党组织、纪检组织：
translation: To all departments of the company, directly affiliated institutions, Party organizations within each unit, and discipline inspection organizations:

source: 为贯彻落实股份公司采购领域突出问题集中治理工作安排部署，根据《中国土木采购领域突出问题集中治理工作方案》有关要求，公司纪委从中夹纪委国家监委网站、地方政府网站及系统内执纪审查通报等案例中摘选部分内容，对照重点核查的采购领域腐败“四类”突出问题，编纂了《采购领域突出问题典型案例汇编》，供各级组织、广大于部职工参阅。汇编材料仅供内部使用，请勿外传，因擅自外传造成不良影响的，依纪依规追究相应人员纪律和法律责任。
translation: To implement the arrangements and plans for addressing the prominent issues in the procurement sector of the company, in accordance with the requirements of the “Work Plan for Addressing Prominent Issues in China’s Construction Procurement Sector,” the company’s discipline inspection department has selected relevant information from the websites of the National Supervisory Commission, local government websites, and internal disciplinary review reports. Based on these selections, they have compiled a collection of “four types of prominent corruption issues” in the procurement sector. This compilation is intended for use by organizations at all levels and all employees. The materials are for internal use only; please do not disclose them to others. Those who disclose them without permission will be held accountable according to discipline and legal regulations.

source: 请各级组织充分运用各类典型案例开展常态化警示教育，营造“不想腐＂的高压氛围，释放对采购领域突出问题深入整治的坚强决心和强烈信号，着力铲除腐败滋生的土壤和条件，推动采购领域突出问题集中治理取得实效。广大于部职工要认真对照检视、举一反三，知敬畏、存戒惧、守底线，要引以为戒、廉洁自律、担当作为，推动企业健康持续发展。
translation: All organizations at all levels should make full use of various typical cases to carry out regular warning education. This will create a strong atmosphere of deterrence against corruption. It will also send a clear signal of the firm determination to address the prominent issues in the procurement sector. Efforts should be made to eliminate the conditions that nurture corruption, thereby achieving effective results in addressing these problems. All employees should carefully examine their own behavior and learn from these examples. They should respect rules and regulations, maintain integrity, and take responsibility for their actions, thereby promoting the healthy and sustainable development of the enterprise.

translation: I. Interest-based alliance arrangements involve companies forming alliances with suppliers. By intervening directly, giving secret instructions, or using their influence to manipulate things, they can turn public resources into benefits for specific individuals (2 examples)

source: 案例1：浙江省台州市黄岩区妇幼保健计划生育服务中心违规插手干预采购案
translation: Case 1: Violation of regulations by Huangyan District Maternal and Child Health and Family Planning Service Center in Taizhou City, Zhejiang Province, in its interference with procurement processes

source: 2012 年至2019 年，浙江省台州市黄岩区妇幼保健计划生育服务中心原党支部副书记、主任王某某，受在工作中熟识的某彩超设备代理商范某某的请托，在妇幼保健院彩超设备采购招标中，利用自己具有确定设备型号、价格、参数等招标条件的职务便利，在招投标询价阶段使用该公司彩超，并帮助范某某完善招标文件，使得范某某公司先后5 次中标，致使其他企业失去公平竞争机会。王某某先后收受范某某回扣共计53 万元。2021 年4 月，王某某受到开除党籍处分，并被取消退休待遇。2021 年7 月，王某某被判处有期徒刑三年四个月。
translation: From 2012 to 2019, Wang Moumou, the former deputy secretary of the Party branch and director of the Maternal and Child Health and Family Planning Service Center in Huangyan District, Taizhou City, Zhejiang Province, accepted a request from Fan Moumou, a supplier of color Doppler ultrasound equipment whom he knew well from his work. Using his position as someone who was responsible for determining the specifications, prices, and other conditions related to the procurement of such equipment, Wang Moumou used the color Doppler ultrasound equipment from that company during the bidding process. He also helped Fan Moumou prepare the bidding documents, allowing his company to win the bids five times. As a result, other companies lost their chances for fair competition. Wang Moumou accepted bribes totaling 530,000 yuan from Fan Moumou. In April 2021, Wang Moumou was expelled from the Party and had his retirement benefits revoked. In July 2021, he was sentenced to three years and four months in prison.

source: 案例2：中国建筑第七工程局有限公司原豫东公司党委书记、总经理雷某某案件
translation: Case 2: The case of Lei Moumou, former Party Secretary and General Manager of the Yuandong Branch of China Architecture Seventh Engineering Bureau Co., Ltd.

source:
2019 年12 月，经指定管辖程序，河南省郑州市监委对中国建筑集团有限公司下属中国建筑第七工程局有限公司（以下简称中建七局）原豫东公司党委书记、总经理雷某某涉嫌职务违法犯罪问题立案调查并采取留置措施。2008 年，雷某某在协调地方政府及开拓市场过程中，积攒了一些所谓的人脉和资源，能够借此联络工程项目，因此吸引了中建七局多家内部单位以及外部承

包商、供应商围绕在其身边。雷某某便在如何“吃”项目上动起了歪脑筋，设置了“分配门槛”——无论内部单位还是外部合作商，无论项目大小，要想求他办事先得“上供”。为了能够接到工程以及顺利结算工程款，一些单位争先恐后地向雷某某表达“诚意”，有的以“节礼”名义送，有的以“营销奖”名义送，从一万元到几万元，再到几十万元，金额越来越大。雷某某沉溺于各种恭维和讨好声中不能自拔，甚至认为自己帮助这些单位接了活、挣了钱，解决了他们的大问题，“吃点利息”很正常。12年间，雷某某先后为中建七局6 家内部单位、11 家外部合作单位在承接部分项目装饰装修、园林绿化、消防等工程以及结算工程款上提供帮助，索要或收受好处费700 万余元，其中涉及中建七局23 名干部。经查，雷某某违反廉洁纪律，收受可能影响公正执行公务的礼品礼金；涉嫌受贿犯罪。2020 年3 月，雷某某受到开除党籍处分，被取消退休待遇。同年4 月，雷某某因犯受贿罪，被判处有期徒刑七年。
translation: In December 2019, through designated procedures, the Zhengzhou Supervision Commission in Henan Province initiated an investigation into Lei Moumou, the former Party Secretary and General Manager of the Yudong Branch of China State Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as CSCEC-7). Lei Moumou was suspected of engaging in illegal and corrupt activities. In 2008, during his work involving coordination with local governments and market development, Lei Moumou managed to build up a network of contacts and resources that allowed him to influence project matters. This gave him the ability to attract many internal units of CSCEC-7, as well as external contractors and suppliers, to work under his control. Lei Moumou began to use this power to gain advantages in obtaining projects. He set up “barriers” for those who wanted to work with him—whether they were internal units or external partners, regardless of the size of the project. To get projects, some units rushed to show their “sincereness” to Lei Moumou, offering gifts ranging from 10,000 yuan to hundreds of thousands of yuan. Lei Moumou became addicted to these gifts and favors, believing that by helping these units obtain projects and earn money, he was doing something right. Over the course of 12 years, Lei Moumou helped 6 internal units and 11 external partners with projects related to decoration, landscaping, and fire protection. He demanded or accepted bribes totaling over 7 million yuan, involving 23 employees of CSCEC-7. It was found that Lei Moumou violated ethical standards by accepting gifts and money that could affect the fair execution of his duties. In March 2020, Lei Moumou was expelled from the Party and had his retirement benefits revoked. In April of the same year, he was sentenced to seven years in prison for bribery.

source: 二、承揽关联业务牟利，主要是企业人员成立“影子公司”,或指使、默许、纵容亲属和特定关系人依附企业开办公司,承揽关联业务、攫取非法利益（2 例）
translation: II. Profiting from related business contracts by engaging in fraudulent activities. This mainly involves companies using employees to establish “shell companies,” or allowing relatives and people with special relationships to start companies under the company’s control, thereby engaging in related business activities and obtaining illegal profits (2 cases)

source: 案例3：某企业某项目经理陈某某违规经商办企业问题
translation: Case 3: Chen Moumou, a project manager at a certain company, engaged in illegal business activities.

source:
某企业某项目经理陈某某，2016 年6 月至2022 年9 月，其岳父参股的劳务公司与企业发生关联交易8500 余万元;其配偶亲属的公司与某项目发生关联交易1700 余万元;在历次专项整

治中均未如实报告。受到撤销党内职务、行政撤职处分。
translation: Chen Moumou, a project manager at a certain enterprise, from June 2016 to September 2022, had transactions involving more than 85 million yuan with the labor company in which his father-in-law invested. His spouse’s company also had transactions involving more than 17 million yuan with that same project. He failed to report these transactions truthfully during all the inspections. As a result, he was dismissed from his party position and removed from his administrative duties.

source: 案例4：某企业某项目部经理马某贪污、受贿案
translation: Case 4: The case of Manager Ma, who was in charge of a certain project department at a company, committing corruption and accepting bribes

source: 某企业某项目部经理马某，滥用职权，损公肥私，安排亲属在所任职项目供应材料、租赁设备，指使项目物资和财务部门通过虚假招标、高价采购等方式贪污公款700 余万元；伙同亲属为他人在材料供应、资金拨付等事项上提供帮助，收受他人钱款200 余万元；利用职务便利，挪用公款1100 余万元给他人从事营利活动。马某因犯贪污罪、受贿罪、挪用公款罪，被判处有期徒刑十二年六个月，并处罚金160 万元；其亲属犯贪污罪、受贿罪，被判处有期徒刑五年六个月，并处罚金70 万元。马某受到开除党籍、开除公职处分。
translation: Ma, the manager of a certain project department in a company, abused his power and engaged in acts that harmed the public interest for personal gain. He arranged for his relatives to supply materials and rent equipment for the projects he was in charge of. He also instructed the project’s materials and finance departments to embezzle over 7 million yuan by using false bidding processes and high-priced purchases. He colluded with his relatives to provide assistance in matters related to material supply and funding, receiving more than 2 million yuan in exchange. Using his position, he misappropriated over 11 million yuan for profit-making activities. Ma was convicted of embezzlement, bribery, and misappropriation of public funds. He was sentenced to twelve years and six months in prison, along with a fine of 1.6 million yuan. His relatives were also convicted of embezzlement and bribery, and they were sentenced to five years and six months in prison, along with a fine of 700,000 yuan. Ma was expelled from the Party and from his position as an employee of the company.

source: 三、虚假采购套取公款，主要是企业人员通过虚签合同、虚增业务、虚开发票套取公款（3 例）
translation: III. Fraudulent procurement to obtain public funds, mainly involving corporate employees who obtain public funds by signing fake contracts, exaggerating business activities, and issuing fake invoices (3 cases)

source: 案例5：某企业境外子公司某地区经理部总经理田某某违纪违法案
translation: Case 5: The case of Tian, the general manager of the regional management department of an overseas subsidiary of a company, who violated laws and regulations

source: 2019 年8 月至2022 年2 月期间，田某某利用任职地区经理部总经理，某市政道路新建及改造项目经理工作职务便利，在路灯采购过程中谋取利益，利用其实际控制的当地公司与项目签订采购合同，再与实际供应商签订采购合同，套取100 余万元；田某某还存在其他违纪违规和涉嫌贪污罪、巨额财产来源不明罪。田某某被地方监委留置，受到开除党籍、开除（解除劳动合同）处分。目前，田某某已被移送司法机关。
translation: From August 2019 to February 2022, Tian Moumou took advantage of his position as the general manager of the regional management department and as the project manager for the construction and renovation of municipal roads. He used these positions to obtain benefits in the procurement process for street lights. He signed procurement contracts with local companies under his control, and then signed contracts with actual suppliers, thereby stealing over 1 million yuan. Tian Moumou also committed other disciplinary violations and was suspected of corruption and misappropriating large amounts of money from unknown sources. Tian Moumou was placed under suspension by the local supervisory committee and was expelled from the party and had his employment contract terminated. Currently, Tian Moumou has been transferred to the judicial authorities.

source: 案例6：某企业某项目部经理秦某某、等人贪污、受贿、挪用公款案
translation: Case 6: The case of Qin Moumou, the manager of a certain project department in a company, and others involved in corruption, bribery, and embezzlement of public funds.

source: 某企业某项目部经理秦某某、常务副经理程某、总经济师刘某某、设备物资部长杨某某等六人，通过虚增工程量、增加合同外项目等方式对供应商超计价、超付款3000 余万元。秦某某因犯贪污罪、受贿罪、挪用公款罪被判处有期徒刑十三年，并处罚金65 万元；杨某某因犯职务侵占罪、非国家工作人员受贿罪、挪用公款罪被判处有期徒刑五年六个月，并处罚金30 万元。秦某某、杨某某等六人受到开除党籍、开除公职处分，其他三十一名责任人受到党政纪处分或组织处理。
translation: Six people, including Qin Moumou, the manager of a certain project department in the company, Cheng Mou, the executive deputy manager, Liu Moumou, the chief economist, and Yang Moumou, the head of the equipment and materials department, overcharged suppliers by more than 30 million yuan by inflating the amount of work required and adding additional projects to the contracts. Qin Moumou was sentenced to thirteen years in prison for embezzlement, bribery, and misappropriation of public funds. Yang Moumou was sentenced to five years and six months in prison for embezzlement, bribery, and misappropriation of public funds. Qin Moumou and Yang Moumou were expelled from their party and removed from their official positions. Another thirty-one individuals were given party and administrative penalties or organizational actions.

source: 案例7：某企业原总经理助理兼某项目部经理刘某某等人贪污、受贿案
translation: Case 7: Case of corruption and bribery by Liu Moumou, the former assistant to the general manager of a company, and the manager of a certain project department

source: 某企业原总经理助理兼某项目部经理刘某某，利用职务便利，在工程承揽、资金拨付等方面为他人提供帮助，非法收受他人钱款200 余万元；伙同项目总会计师张某某、总经济师袁某等人，虚增工程量套取资金，以奖金名义侵吞项目公款200 余万元。刘某某因犯贪污罪、受贿罪，被判处有期徒刑七年六个月，并处罚金40 万元；张某某因犯贪污罪，被判处有期徒刑三年、缓刑五年，并处罚金20 万元；袁某因犯贪污罪，被判处有期徒刑三年、缓刑四年，并处罚金20 万元。以上三人均受到开除党籍、开除公职处分。
translation: Liu Moumou, the former assistant to the general manager of a company and the manager of a certain project department, took advantage of his position to provide assistance to others in matters related to project contracting and funding allocation. He illegally accepted more than 2 million yuan in bribes from others. Together with Zhang Moumou, the chief accountant of the project, and Yuan Mou, the chief economist, they inflated the amount of work done in order to obtain funds. They also embezzled over 2 million yuan of public funds under the guise of bonuses. Liu Moumou was convicted of corruption and bribery, and was sentenced to seven years and six months in prison, along with a fine of 400,000 yuan. Zhang Moumou was convicted of corruption and sentenced to three years in prison, with a suspension of execution for five years, along with a fine of 200,000 yuan. Yuan Mou was also convicted of corruption and sentenced to three years in prison, with a suspension of execution for four years, along with a fine of 200,000 yuan. All three were expelled from their party and removed from their public positions.

source: 四、奢靡享乐挥霍浪费,主要是企业人员讲排场、图享乐,超标奢华采购,挥霍浪费国家资材（4 例）
translation: IV. Excessive spending and wastefulness occur mainly because company employees prefer a luxurious lifestyle and seek pleasure. They make excessive purchases that exceed what is necessary, thereby wasting national resources (4 examples)

source: 案例8：某省属国企相关负责人挥霍浪费公共财产案
translation: Case 8: A relevant official of a provincial-owned enterprise who squandered public property

source: 某省属国企相关负责人挥霍浪费公共财产，审批同意在单位办公区域安装使用84 部香氛系统，支出费用84.9 万元，造成不良影响。因其还存在其他严重违纪违法问题，被开除党籍、开除公职，其涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关依法审查起诉。
translation: A relevant official from a provincial-owned enterprise squandered public funds by approving the installation of 84 aroma systems in the company’s office area. This resulted in expenses of 849,000 yuan, causing negative consequences. Due to his other serious violations of laws and regulations, he was expelled from the Party and his job. His criminal-related issues have been referred to the procuratorial authorities for legal investigation.

source: 案例9：上海市松江区某居委会超标准采购问题
translation: Case 9: Over-standard procurement by a neighborhood committee in Songjiang District, Shanghai

source: 上海市松江区委第三巡察组通过一张电脑配件报销单，发现某居委会购买电脑CPU、主板及内存时，支出金额远远超过正常办公电脑配件的价格，发票明细中的三个电脑配件型号均属于高端电脑配置。经查，该居委会干部范某以办公电脑卡顿为由，违规采购高端配置，为方便打游戏，将该组电脑配件拿回家后与自己的旧电脑配件互换。2025 年5 月，范某被立案审查。
translation: The Third Inspection Team of the Songjiang District Committee in Shanghai discovered through a computer parts reimbursement form that a neighborhood committee purchased computer CPUs, motherboards, and memory at prices far exceeding those of regular office computer parts. The three types of computer parts listed on the invoice were all high-end configurations. It was found that Fan, a staff member of the neighborhood committee, illegally purchased these high-end components under the pretext of dealing with computer lag issues. To facilitate gaming, he took the computer parts home and replaced them with his own old computer parts. In May 2025, Fan was placed under investigation.

source: 案例10：浙江省某区广电传媒集团下属国企陈某擅自扩大范围发放纪念品问题
translation: Case 10: A state-owned enterprise under the Guangdian Media Group in a district of Zhejiang Province issued souvenirs beyond its authorized scope.

source: 2018 年，经国企班子集体讨论同意，使用公款购买50 条礼品“阳诗悦”真丝方巾，单价182 元，共计9100 元，用于举办委托方外宣形象的宣传片推介解说词大赛发放给参赛选手，其中18 条丝由参赛选手18 人签字领取，另外32 条丝巾由委托方27人、某广告公司3 人和2 名记者领取。针对陈某在举办解说词大赛过程中，存在擅自扩大纪念品发放范围的违纪问题，给予陈某诫勉问责处理，并对分管领导进行了提醒谈话。
translation: In 2018, after collective discussion by the management team of the state-owned enterprise, it was decided to use public funds to purchase 50 silk scarves under the brand “Yang Shi Yue”. The unit price was 182 yuan, totaling 9,100 yuan. These scarves were intended to be distributed as prizes in the competition for creating promotional videos for the client’s image. Of these 50 scarves, 18 were received by the 18 participants who took part in the competition. The remaining 32 scarves were given to 27 people from the client’s team, 3 employees from an advertising company, and 2 journalists. Regarding Chen Mou’s violation of regulations by expanding the scope of distribution of these gifts during the competition, he was given a warning and disciplinary action. The responsible leader also received a reminder talk.

source: 案例11：广东省江门市某区人民法院违规使用公款购买、发放纪念品问题
translation: Case 11: A local people’s court in Jiangmen City, Guangdong Province, used public funds to purchase and distribute souvenirs in an irregular manner.

source: 2018 年12 月，某区人民法院为庆祝新办公大楼落成，违规用公款采购了250 套以新办公大楼为模型的笔筒，并将笔筒作为纪念品发放给该院干部。该批笔筒每套单价490 元，共计花费12.25 万元。对此，时任区人民法院党组书记、院长黄某和时任分管财务的副院长肖某应负主要领导责任。黄某、肖某还存在其他违纪问题。2022 年4 月，黄某受到党内严重警告、政务记大过处分，肖某受到党内警告处分。
translation: In December 2018, a local people’s court organized the purchase of 250 pen holders using public funds to celebrate the completion of its new office building. These pen holders were modeled after the new building itself and distributed as souvenirs to the court’s staff. Each pen holder cost 490 yuan, resulting in a total expenditure of 122,500 yuan. Huang, who was then the Party secretary and president of the court, and Xiao, who was in charge of finance, were primarily responsible for this violation. Huang and Xiao also committed other disciplinary violations. In April 2022, Huang received a severe warning from the Party, while Xiao received a warning.
